description: Liniennetz öffentlicher Verkehr is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Basel-Stadt. Das Netz des öffentlichen Verkehrs zeigt die Linien von Bus und Tram in Basel-Stadt, die Haltestellen von Bahn, Bus und Tram in der Region Basel sowie die Halteorte (Teilhaltestellen) der Tram- und Buslinien in Basel-Stadt. Zusätzlich werden die Fernbushaltestellen, die Basler Fähren, das Rhytaxi sowie die Terminals der Kabinenschifffahrt dargestellt. Coverage: Kanton Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Basel-Stadt. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
